question: Prisoners made shoes and bags. Who got the money from their work?
answer: The money went to the director. Prisoners were forced to work in the fields and to make shoes and bags. Almost all of the money went neither to the state nor to the prisoners, but into the director's own pockets.
move: Forced labour turned the prison into a private business for one man.
